name: Tlog photo library
integration: Use an isolated document: the original component owns fixed toolbar/viewer layers, global IDs, history, scroll restoration and document/window input listeners.
Insert tlog.html (includes SVG symbols, all required sibling layers and embedded TlogData) before loading tlog.js once.
index.html is the ready-to-host static test with this structure already embedded.
data: 81entries/231media,222photos+9videos. pages1 means no Shopify pagination request. Keep pages1 for static hosting and merge future data into the embedded TlogData before publishing. tlog-data.json is the reusable source data; sync it with the embedded JSON when editing.
dependencies: No external JavaScript libraries required. Montserrat fonts and Fugazi image/video media remain externally hosted; availability is recorded in asset-manifest.json.
adaptations: Copy Link now uses current origin/path/query plus #photo-ID instead of the Shopify search-template endpoint.
Home returns to the project root via ../../.
Minimal source-theme typography/reset and30px desktop/15px mobile host gutters replace the omitted shop header/cart shell.

Optional ?embed=testing suppresses viewer pushState/replaceState/popstate and scrollRestoration changes. Viewer Back closes locally. Copy Link omits the embed query and targets the standalone library.
reference: tlog.original.html/css/js preserve unmodified feature extraction; source-analysis.json records identical feature hashes in both uploaded attachments. Raw asset inventory was consolidated into asset-manifest.json.
persistence: Source localStorage keys fugazi-tlog-likes, fugazi-tlog-cols and fugazi-tlog-view are retained. Favorites stay on each visitor device; no account or server write.
api: Original self-initializing IIFE, one instance per document; no destroy or mount API.
save_share: Uses native Web Share when files are supported, otherwise downloads a fetched Blob. Browser permissions and CDN CORS apply. The source in-memory file cache keeps the last5 files.
compatibility: Source native scrolling, pointer/touch gestures, modern CSS container sizing and reduced-motion rules retained. Physical phone gestures and native mobile Share sheet were not tested.

testing_integration.lifecycle: testing/photo-section.js lazily preserves one iframe, intercepts Home to restore Testing, restores parent focus and pauses hidden frame media. Parent navigation and Music audio are independent.
testing_integration.standalone: Default no-query mode retains original standalone hash/history behavior.
